why.title: Why Kyrgyzstan?
why.subtitle: Central Asia's last frontier — raw, authentic, and awe-inspiring
why.item1_desc: Over 90% of the country is mountainous, offering pristine landscapes rarely touched by mass tourism.
why.item2_desc: Experience 3,000 years of living nomadic heritage — yurt stays, eagle hunters, and traditional crafts.
why.item3_desc: Ancient caravanserais, rock carvings and medieval fortresses tell the story of a great civilization.
why.item4_desc: World-class trekking, heli-skiing, horse riding, and white-water rafting in one compact destination.

kelsuu_tashrabat.name: Kel-Suu & Tash-Rabat Explorer
kelsuu_tashrabat.overview: A 7-day adventure through the most remote corners of Kyrgyzstan. Visit the turquoise Kel-Suu Lake hidden in mountains near the Chinese border and the medieval Tash-Rabat caravanserai — a true gem of the Great Silk Road.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bishkek
itinerary.desc: Airport pickup, hotel check-in, welcome dinner and trip briefing.

itinerary.title: Bishkek → Naryn
itinerary.desc: Drive over Dolon Pass (3038m), mountain lunch, overnight at a guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Naryn → Tash-Rabat
itinerary.desc: Visit the 15th-century caravanserai, explore surroundings, sleep in yurts.

itinerary.title: Tash-Rabat → Kel-Suu
itinerary.desc: Off-road 4×4 drive, horseback ride to the lake, sunset photoshoot.

itinerary.title: Kel-Suu Lake
itinerary.desc: Full day at the lake, trekking, time with shepherds and nomadic traditions.

itinerary.title: Return to Naryn
itinerary.desc: Drive back, visit Koshoy-Korgon fortress, overnight in Naryn.

itinerary.title: Naryn → Bishkek → Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning drive to the capital, farewell lunch, airport transfer.

enilchek.name: Enilchek Glacier Expedition
enilchek.overview: A 12-day expedition to one of the largest mountain glaciers on the planet. See Khan Tengri Peak (7010m) and Pobeda Peak (7439m) — the highest summits of the Tien Shan range. Helicopter access into the very heart of the glacier.
highlights: Views of Khan Tengri and Pobeda Peak
Ice trekking on the South Enilchek

itinerary.title: Bishkek — Karakol
itinerary.desc: Drive along Issyk-Kul north shore, gear check and briefing.

itinerary.title: Karakol — Maida-Adyr
itinerary.desc: Transfer to mountain camp, acclimatisation at 2800m.

itinerary.title: Helicopter transfer
itinerary.desc: Flight to Enilchek base camp (4000m), tent setup.

itinerary.title: Acclimatisation days
itinerary.desc: Radial hikes, ice training, rest.

itinerary.title: Merzbacher Lake
itinerary.desc: Trek to the legendary pulsating lake.

itinerary.title: Days 6-10: Glacier program
itinerary.desc: Trekking program across the glacier, views of 7000m peaks.

itinerary.title: Day 11-12: Return
itinerary.desc: Helicopter evacuation, drive to Bishkek, departure.

issyk_kul.name: Issyk-Kul Discovery Loop
issyk_kul.overview: The perfect tour for those who want to explore Kyrgyzstan without serious physical effort. Loop around the country's pearl — Issyk-Kul Lake — see Skazka Canyon, petroglyphs, hot springs and enjoy beach relaxation.

itinerary.title: Arrival — Cholpon-Ata
itinerary.desc: Transfer from Bishkek, hotel check-in, beach time.

itinerary.title: Cholpon-Ata
itinerary.desc: Petroglyph museum, yacht trip, spa treatments.

itinerary.title: Karakol
itinerary.desc: Dungan Mosque, Russian Church, international cuisine.

itinerary.title: Skazka Canyon
itinerary.desc: Drive to south shore, trek through red rocks.

itinerary.title: Return to Bishkek
itinerary.desc: National cuisine tasting, airport transfer.

nomadic.name: Nomadic Life & Eagle Hunting
nomadic.overview: A 9-day immersion in the living nomadic culture of Kyrgyzstan. Stay in yurts with shepherds at Son-Kul jailoo, learn horseback riding and witness the legendary eagle hunt — an ancient art over 3000 years old.
highlights: Live with a berkutchi (eagle hunter) family

itinerary.title: Bishkek — Kochkor
itinerary.desc: Felt-making craft introduction, shyrdak masterclass.

itinerary.title: Kochkor — Son-Kul
itinerary.desc: Drive over a 3016m pass, yurt check-in.

itinerary.title: Son-Kul
itinerary.desc: Horseback trek around the lake, dinner with a shepherd family.

itinerary.title: Son-Kul — Bokonbaevo
itinerary.desc: Drive to Issyk-Kul, meet a berkutchi family.

itinerary.title: Eagle hunt
itinerary.desc: Demonstration of the ancient hunt, falconry basics.

itinerary.title: Kok-Boru
itinerary.desc: Watch or participate in the national horse game.

itinerary.title: Skazka Canyon
itinerary.desc: Trekking the fairy-tale rocks, photoshoot.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.desc: Drive to Bishkek, farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Airport transfer, end of tour.
